# Issue #41: `slugify` produces double hyphens and trailing hyphens

`slugify("Hello,  World!")` returns `"hello--world-"` but should return `"hello-world"`.
Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

Please fix `textkit/slug.py`. Do not change the public signature.

arguments.summary: Fixed `slugify` in `textkit/slug.py` by: (1) changing the regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` so consecutive non-alphanumeric characters collapse into a single hyphen instead of multiple hyphens, and (2) adding `text.strip("-")` to remove leading/trailing hyphens. This resolves both issues: `slugify("Hello,  World!")` now returns `"hello-world"` instead of `"hello--world-"`, and `slugify("--a--b--")` returns `"a-b"`.
